flags.message: The provisioned document of kind 'brief-in-opposition' concatenates two distinct filings under one cert-stage kind: the Mar 6 2026 cert-stage BIO and the Jul 13 2026 merits brief for respondent (documents.json shows both URLs pipe-joined, 91 pages, truncated). On a merits cell this was actually the most valuable input, but the kind label misdescribes the content, and petitioner's merits brief (filed Jun 1 2026) and reply (Aug 12 2026) were not fetched at all — the document pipeline appears to fetch only cert-kind documents even when the cell is merits-stage.
